The '''Krnay system''' was located in the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the location [[Krnay]].<ref name="TEGAS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Krnay [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-16.<ref name="TEA" />
